# Architecture and ADR Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System — URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the architecture requirements and decision records (domains 2 Architecture and 3 ADRs)
**Created**: 2026-09-26
**Feature**: [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADR index](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Tags**: `[Mandatory]` / `[Enhancement]`; `Detects:` names the guide failure trap an item guards against.

## Architecture Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the system boundary, actors, external dependencies, and trust boundaries documented? [Completeness, Plan §1] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Is data ownership defined for every persisted table, including the components allowed to write it? [Completeness, Plan §1 data ownership] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "the application plane must not depend on the control plane" stated with a verification method? [Measurability, Constitution VII, Spec §NFR-MNT-01, ADR-001] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the single sanctioned crossing point between the planes (the port) specified with its operations and required permissions? [Clarity, Plan §3 agent contract, ADR-018] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is a responsible component assigned for each URL-shortener concern (API delivery, domain logic, codes, validation, redirect, persistence, analytics, expiry, health, telemetry, configuration)? [Completeness, Plan §2 components] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the versioned API and schema deliverables (OpenAPI, artifact schemas, migrations) listed with versions and executable validation? [Completeness, Plan §2 deliverables, contracts/CHANGELOG.md] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Does each API or schema change record owner, version impact, compatibility, consumers, tests, documentation, rollout or migration, and required approval? [Completeness, Plan §2 change impact records] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Are compatibility and migration rules defined for breaking versus non-breaking changes? [Clarity, contracts/CHANGELOG.md, data-model.md migration rules] [Mandatory]

## Architecture Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is the orchestration concurrency model (locks, transaction boundaries, where agents execute) specified well enough to reason about races? [Clarity, Plan §3, ADR-006] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the single-instance limitation and the multi-instance path documented? [Assumption, Spec §ASM-01, ADR-006, research BL-05] [Mandatory]

## Architecture Drift

- [ ] CHK011 Is a procedure defined for an approved design that proves impractical (stop, document, update plan or ADR, approve, regenerate tasks, re-analyze)? [Gap, Constitution Development Workflow] Detects: undocumented architecture drift. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Are architecture rules defined in a form that fails the build when violated? [Measurability, ADR-001, ADR-013] Detects: undocumented architecture drift. [Mandatory]

## ADR Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Does each of the guide's 16 ADR topics have an ADR or an explicit statement that none is needed? [Completeness, docs/adr/README.md §1] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK014 Does each ADR record options with advantages, disadvantages, risks, implementation impact, and assessment implications? [Completeness, docs/adr] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK015 Does each ADR state its reversibility and an executable validation approach? [Measurability, docs/adr] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK016 Are candidate directives (Java 21, Spring Boot, H2 runtime database) distinguished from assistant proposals inside the ADRs? [Clarity, ADR-002, ADR-003, gate register] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK017 Do all ADRs remain `Proposed` until the candidate records acceptance? [Consistency, Constitution III] Detects: architecture change without formal approval. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK018 Are conflicts between the ADRs and the plan recorded with their resolution? [Consistency, docs/adr/README.md §4] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK019 Do the ADRs that depend on provisional clarification answers (Q1, Q2, Q4, Q5) state that dependency? [Traceability, ADR-008, ADR-010, ADR-015..ADR-018] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK020 Are rejected alternatives for the orchestration engine recorded with reasons tied to requirements? [Completeness, ADR-005, research R-12] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Review owner: the human candidate (Gate G4)
